commentaries.author: Parimelazhagar
commentaries.text: Ruin from bad deeds and increase from good deeds are laid down beforehand for everyone. Knowing this, not to lean in your heart because of them is the beauty of the wise. To lean is to take one side, thinking these come now, to avoid ruin or win increase. Their cause is past deeds, not leaning.
